product_category_check.name: product_category_check
product_category_check.value: "product"."category" is null or char_length(btrim("product"."category")) between 1 and 60

stock_movement_sign_check.name: stock_movement_sign_check
stock_movement_sign_check.value: case "stock_movement"."kind" when 'entrada' then "stock_movement"."quantity" > 0 when 'anulacion' then "stock_movement"."quantity" > 0 when 'venta' then "stock_movement"."quantity" < 0 else "stock_movement"."quantity" <> 0 end

stock_movement_reason_check.name: stock_movement_reason_check
stock_movement_reason_check.value: ("stock_movement"."kind" <> 'ajuste' or char_length(btrim(coalesce("stock_movement"."reason", ''))) >= 3) and ("stock_movement"."reason" is null or char_length("stock_movement"."reason") <= 300)

stock_movement_reference_check.name: stock_movement_reference_check
stock_movement_reference_check.value: ("stock_movement"."kind" in ('venta','anulacion')) = ("stock_movement"."reference" is not null) and ("stock_movement"."reference" is null or char_length("stock_movement"."reference") between 1 and 80)

store_delivery_method_price_check.name: store_delivery_method_price_check
store_delivery_method_price_check.value: ("store_delivery_method"."cost" = 'fijo') = ("store_delivery_method"."price_cents" is not null) and ("store_delivery_method"."price_cents" is null or "store_delivery_method"."price_cents" >= 0)

store_delivery_method_deal_check.name: store_delivery_method_deal_check
store_delivery_method_deal_check.value: ("store_delivery_method"."max_discount_cents" is null and "store_delivery_method"."free_from_cents" is null) or "store_delivery_method"."cost" in ('fijo','por_zona')

store_delivery_method_deal_amounts_check.name: store_delivery_method_deal_amounts_check
store_delivery_method_deal_amounts_check.value: ("store_delivery_method"."max_discount_cents" is null or "store_delivery_method"."max_discount_cents" > 0) and ("store_delivery_method"."free_from_cents" is null or "store_delivery_method"."free_from_cents" > 0)

store_invitation_pending_idx.name: store_invitation_pending_idx
store_invitation_pending_idx.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

store_invitation_closed_check.name: store_invitation_closed_check
store_invitation_closed_check.value: ("store_invitation"."accepted_at" is null or "store_invitation"."accepted_by" is not null) and ("store_invitation"."revoked_at" is null or "store_invitation"."revoked_by" is not null) and ("store_invitation"."accepted_at" is null or "store_invitation"."revoked_at" is null)
